CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_single_owner ON auth_users(role) WHERE role='owner'

CREATE TABLE accounts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,computer_id TEXT REFERENCES computers(id),slot INTEGER,name TEXT,status TEXT,note TEXT,douyin_id TEXT,homepage TEXT,work_count INTEGER,last_collected TEXT, collection_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', collection_error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', last_attempted TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', account_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待确认', parent_account_id TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id), registered_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', auxiliary_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待确认', lifecycle_note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', registration_phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', card_stability TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待确认', password_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待确认', phone_device_id TEXT REFERENCES phone_devices(id), phone_device_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', phone_device_note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', office_group TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', nurture_started TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',UNIQUE(computer_id,slot))

CREATE TABLE auth_audit(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,at INTEGER NOT NULL,actor_id INTEGER,
      actor_name TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,target TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE auth_limits(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,failures INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE auth_migrations(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE auth_sessions(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_users(id),
      csrf TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE auth_setup(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE auth_users(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,username TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('owner','admin','employee','viewer')),
      permissions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
      password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE collection_jobs(account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES accounts(id), homepage TEXT NOT NULL, douyin_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', token TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE collection_settings(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),auto_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, paused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pause_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE collection_worker(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),seen REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',command TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE computers(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT,shadow_account TEXT,ip TEXT,operator TEXT,category TEXT)
CREATE TABLE daily(account_id TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id),day TEXT,published INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(published IN (0,1)),PRIMARY KEY(account_id,day))
CREATE TABLE imports(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE nurture_images(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      account_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id),cycle INTEGER NOT NULL,day TEXT NOT NULL,
      mime TEXT NOT NULL,content BLOB NOT NULL,actor TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE nurture_records(
      account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES accounts(id),started_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      completed_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',cycle INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      image_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, verification_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待检查', verification_owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', verification_note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', verification_updated_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', workflow TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待开始', active_since TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', banked_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, paused_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', periods TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', legacy_started_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE operations_history(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,group_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      at INTEGER NOT NULL,actor_id INTEGER,actor_name TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,entity TEXT NOT NULL,
      before_json TEXT,after_json TEXT)

CREATE TABLE operations_previews(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
      expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE phone_cards(
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, phone TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', carrier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待确认',
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待确认', owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        location TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', expires_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', keeper TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', code_contact TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', code_note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', ownership TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待确认', code_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '无待办', return_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待确认', return_due TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', returned_on TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', source_note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE phone_devices(
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '待确认',
        state_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        location TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE publishing_layout(
      batch TEXT NOT NULL,computer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES computers(id),slot INTEGER NOT NULL,
      account_id TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id),label TEXT NOT NULL,office TEXT NOT NULL,
      source_cell TEXT NOT NULL,source_url TEXT NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(batch,computer_id,slot))

CREATE TABLE publishing_layout_links(
      batch TEXT NOT NULL,computer_id TEXT NOT NULL,slot INTEGER NOT NULL,
      previous_reason TEXT NOT NULL,actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL,updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY(batch,computer_id,slot),
      FOREIGN KEY(batch,computer_id,slot) REFERENCES publishing_layout(batch,computer_id,slot))
CREATE TABLE publishing_layout_state(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),batch TEXT NOT NULL)
